independent_review.disposition: Approved scoped RM-102 closure: combined prior user/browser review and current independent authentication/public-language review, real HTTP selected-adapter integration, strict negative cases, and SQLite/PostgreSQL declared credential evidence satisfy the task acceptance. No unresolved blocking finding. This does not close RM-104 authored service endpoints or RM-109/RM-110 full frozen golden acceptance.

reviewed_invariants: Credential roles belong to one authoritative entity/store and are distinct; required identity/reference/verifier/expiry/revocation types and constructible active state are checked.
Service.name supplies explicit unique nonsecret Text subject; current service_id is checked so name reuse cannot rebind an existing credential.

Declared credential row owns verifier, expiry, active state and revocation. Private metadata holds identity/strategy/key/binding facts plus verifierDigest for integrity, never a verifier/lifecycle fallback.
Issuance rechecks and locks current service in the same database transaction as both row writes; transaction-local queries avoid SQLite serialization reentry.
Direct keys, exchange, refresh and fresh signed requests check live credential/current service. Ordinary signed credentials retain bounded lookup-free behavior and their issued expiry.
Revocation updates only selected declared revoked timestamp, leaving sibling credentials and authored active-status value unchanged; no new owner-active permission is imposed.
Legacy internal-only service credential storage remains supported when no declared binding exists.

findings_fixed.finding: Service revoke-by-token passed undefined now into storage.
findings_fixed.resolution: Runtime now binds validated operation clock once; new suite exercises direct and signed host.revoke.

findings_fixed.finding: Generated lifecycle fields could also occupy explicit credential roles, leading to duplicate INSERT columns and contradictory generated-value semantics.
findings_fixed.resolution: Semantic guard rejects generated nonidentity role/active fields; dedicated negative generated expiry/revocation fixtures pass; generated UUID identity remains permitted.

findings_fixed.finding: Changing declared verifier could leave already signed credentials accepted on fresh authority checks.
findings_fixed.resolution: Private canonical SHA-256 verifierDigest is compared with the actual declared verifier; mismatch rejects without using fingerprint as an authentication fallback.

findings_fixed.finding: Earlier proposed mapping used credential verifier as principal subject and mixed credential/service authority.
findings_fixed.resolution: Migration now uses separate explicit credentials binding and Service.name/id authority; service principal subject is Text and verifier stays outside principal/envelope.
